name: Linkedin Ads
shortInfo: Generate leads, drive website traffic and build Brand awareness
brief: Marketing on LinkedIn helps you engage a community of professionals to drive actions that are relevant to your business
about:
Drive website traffic, build awareness & generate higher quality leads with LinkedIn Ads. Maximise B2B growth with personalised ads on the platform for B2B lead generation. Create an ad in minutes. 3.5x higher CVR for B2B. 2x higher engagement.  
  
Learn more about [LinkedIn Ads API documentation.](https://business.linkedin.com/marketing-solutions/ads)
